name: 03-add-assistant-prefix-applied
description: addAssistantPrefix (prompt-converters.js:67-76): a non-empty prompt with no tools and a trailing assistant turn gets the flag `prompt[prompt.length - 1][property] = true` -- the property name is a *parameter*, not the hardcoded `prefix` the Mistral path happens to use, so this fixture passes `prefix` and the sibling fixture passes a different name to prove that. The function returns the same array it mutated (not a copy), which the oracle asserts through both `returned` and `mutated`.
